source.license_note: Real upstream prometheus PR #18838; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: A failed AppendHistogram leaves the memSeries pendingCommit flag set to true, so error-path histogram appends keep series alive across head GC even though no samples are pending.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the tsdb package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: In headAppender.AppendHistogram the pendingCommit flag was set when appendableHistogram returned an error (if err != nil) instead of on success, so failed out-of-order histogram appends wrongly flagged the series as having a pending commit.

ops_fault.description: Series that only ever received failing (out-of-order) histogram appends are never garbage-collected from the head, leaking memory over time.
detection_keywords: series kept alive across head GC
growing head series count with no pending samples
localization_keywords: pendingCommit set on the error branch instead of success
Rollback never clears pendingCommit because sample was never batched
repair_keywords: change condition to if err == nil
do not flag pendingCommit when appendableHistogram errors
guard pendingCommit assignment behind a successful appendability check

visible_context.issue_text: Prometheus head series memory keeps growing: series that only receive rejected out-of-order histogram samples are never cleaned up by head garbage collection.
